updated: 2026-10-22, roguelite designer (design only); 2026-10-23 Main Merger: the Calling rebuild (dream_council_review.md 33) retired Hush-a-bye, Torchbearers, Lapping Water, Rain on the Bank, Stagnant Water and Rot, so those builds take any follow-up of their style ([]) until the designer picks new ones; Old Rain (retired) left the card lists.
rules: Optimal = the online tier's conditions plus: at least one `defining` card taken; `needed` distinct counting cards taken in total (the build's `cards` list from build_sheet.json v2; defining cards are always in that list); at most 1 generic (passing_thread, mixed_grove, quickening, thinning_the_herd), as online; the drift 25 Calling follow-up is one of `follow_up` ([] = any). Pair and grown cards never count for single builds, as online. Cross builds: second family held, `second_family_needed` of its listed cards (a defining card among them) + (needed - second_family_needed) counting cards of the `start_from` build, 1 generic at most in all; the follow-up is on the start family's Calling path. Measured on the same simulated runs, by 50 and by 75.
target: Forced start family: 5-10% of runs optimal by drift 50 and 15-25% by drift 75, no build above 35% by 75 and none below 5% by 75.

spore_spread.flags: No own Rare: mixed_company is the family's only counting Rare and is defining for spore_focus. seeping_in is the core Uncommon (stacks over route length = Windblown). Needed 5 = the whole list, so it requires passing_thread as the one generic.

spore_focus.flags: Needed 5 = all five family cards (no generic in the list). Rot adds stacks to other statuses, which is what mixed_company counts; Sticky Caps does not feed it. mixed_company is offered in ~73% of runs by 75, so the 5-card count does most of the gating here.

spore_support.flags: No Rare in the list: best Uncommons, the two core cards (other families' statuses / Sprouts, both what Borrowed Spores lends from). Feeding Ground pays stack additions from touching Wardens; Stomping Ground's free hits ignore the stacks these cards add.

firefly_spread.flags: Needed 4: the list is 3 family cards + 3 generics and the 1-generic cap allows only 4. gathering_storm is shared with firefly_focus (no own card: core_gap). Torchbearers is the jump source gathering_storm needs; Glowworms only adds light.

firefly_focus.flags: Shares its defining Rare with firefly_spread; the follow-up and nothing_wasted/hammerfall tell them apart. Both Bonfire follow-ups stack jumps on one pack (Pyre re-jumps, ember hits count as jumps), so any.

firefly_support.flags: DESIGN GAP: no counting Rare or Uncommon (chain_of_lanterns is a pair card, thunderstruck a grown card). sparks_fly is a Common, chosen because it is the card that makes other Wardens' hits jump, as Borrowed Light does. Needed 4 = the whole list (3 family + mixed_grove). Expect this build to read high on optimal; it needs a Rare of its own.

dew_spread.flags: No counting Rare (never_quite_dry is a pair card): best Uncommon, the core card. Lapping Water and Spring Flood put full Damp on many nightmares, which last_drop pays per stack when it runs out; Millrace spreads other statuses.

dew_focus.flags: No counting Rare (old_rain, never_quite_dry are pair cards): best Uncommon, the core card. Needed 4 = the whole list (4 cards, no generic). Pond nightmares are already slowed, so both follow-ups work.

dew_support.flags: DESIGN GAP: no Rare and no own card (core_gap). high_tide is the best Uncommon only paired with Rain on the Bank, which adds the touching Wardens' statuses that high_tide counts; that pairing is what makes it this build.

bell_spread.flags: DESIGN GAP: no Rare and no own card (core_gap; second_verse is also on bell_support). Best Uncommon: it fires as nightmares leave each bell along a long route, which is Carrying Tune's shape. Both follow-ups carry rings between bells, so any.

bell_focus.flags: rude_awakening is offered in ~73% of runs by 75 (it is in every bell pool), so the 5-of-7 count and the follow-up do the gating. Hush-a-bye makes the sleepers it wakes; Crescendo does not.

bell_support.flags: No counting Rare (reprise is a pair card): best Uncommon. Needed 5 = the whole list, so it requires mixed_grove. Counterpoint and Chime of Many both reward other Wardens joining the song, so any.

x_spore_firefly.flags: brushfire jumps the Spored damage the carpet makes: the Ignite engine. 3 Firefly + 2 from spore_spread. brushfire is offered ~73% by 75 (always in the pool once Firefly is held).

x_firefly_dew.flags: never_quite_dry keeps Thunderclap's statuses after it goes off, so it can go off again: the loop. old_rain is a payoff on top, not the engine. 3 Dewdrop + 2 from firefly_focus.

x_dew_spore.flags: gone_to_seed turns each Mushrooming into stacks for the next one. Stagnant Water keeps statuses from running down in the pond, so fills come; Whirlpool does not help. 3 Sporeling + 2 from dew_focus.

x_bell_firefly.flags: No fitting Firefly Rare: gathering_storm needs a second jump source and thunderstruck a grown heavy form. Best Uncommon: chain_of_lanterns, which jumps the Reaction itself. Hush-a-bye adds the Drowsy the Reaction needs. 3 Firefly + 2 from bell_focus.
